title: Rust: TDMA beacon verify gate + wire into rpl beacon acceptance
description: Child of b7z9.60 (Rust slice): lichen-core tdma_beacon.rs exposes signed_data/signature_bytes but no beacon_sig verify-gate function; lichen-rpl beacon acceptance never checks the Schnorr48 beacon_sig. Add a verify gate (signature over bytes 0..E-48 against the sender's registered pubkey, fail-closed) in lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs and wire it into lichen-rpl beacon acceptance; consume ccp_beacon_format.json vectors.
